proposed.explanation: Trivializes architect role; BERDE certification depends on substantive design decisions, not just paperwork. Shifts responsibility to contractors; while contractors execute green features, the architect designs them and must specify requirements. Misplaces responsibility; the architect designs for performance but cannot control occupant behavior or operational maintenance post-completion. Architects must integrate BERDE requirements from project inception, make deliberate design choices, coordinate consultant systems, and document decisions to support certification claims. BERDE success depends on architects understanding credits from day one and embedding green design into the design philosophy, not treating it as an afterthought.
